title: REQ · Default manifest and assets paths resolve from the script location
summary: A pure function returns manifestPath and assetsRoot anchored on the script directory
description: Context: the entry block hardcodes cwd-relative paths. Desired behavior: a pure exported function defaultArtPaths(scriptDir) returns the absolute manifest path game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json and the assets root game/public/assets. Why: the CLI must work from any directory and hit the file src/runtime/content.ts imports.
acceptance_criteria: Given scriptDir '/repo/game/frontend/scripts', when defaultArtPaths is called, then manifestPath is '/repo/game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json'
Given the same scriptDir, when defaultArtPaths is called, then assetsRoot is '/repo/game/public/assets'
definition_of_done: defaultArtPaths exported and returns both paths
